subject: Combine selectInput and Conditional under the same renderUI in Shiny

messages.author: e5d2fc6cf8ce8d30
messages.subject: Combine selectInput and Conditional under the same renderUI in Shiny
parts:
Hi All,

I am trying to generate a dynamic widget based on the number of variables a user upload for a shiny app I am creating. A reproducible example is below :

library(shiny)

ui= fluidPage(
  sidebarLayout(
    sidebarPanel(
      selectizeInput(inputId= "invar", label= "invar", 
                     choices= names(mtcars), 
                     selected= names(mtcars)[1],
                     multiple=T),
      uiOutput("invarpdf")

    ),
    mainPanel(
      tableOutput("tab")
    )
  ))


server= function(input, output,session) {
  
  sorted <-  reactive({
    data <- mtcars[ ,c(input$invar)]
    #print(input$invar)
    data})
  
  output$invarpdf<-renderUI({
    numvar<- as.integer(input$varnames)
    lapply(1:numvar, function(i) {
      selectInput(inputId=paste0("distinvar",input$invar[i]),paste0("Please Select Probability Distribution of ", input$invar[i]),
                  choices = c("Normal","Uniform","Triangular"))
      conditionalPanel(condition = "input.distinvarpdf=='Normal'",
                       textInput("invarpdfmean","Please Select Input Variable Mean:",0.25),
                       textInput("invarpdfsd","Please Select Input Variable Standard Deviation", 0.02))
      conditionalPanel(condition = "input.distinvarpdf=='Uniform'",
                       textInput("invarpdfmin","Please Select Minimum Input Variable Value:",0.18),
                       textInput("invarpdfmax","Please Select Maximum Input Variable Value", 0.3))
      conditionalPanel(condition = "input.distinvarpdf=='Triangular'",
                       textInput("invarpdfmin","Please Select Minimum Input Variable Value:",0.18),
                       textInput("invarpdfmax","Please Select Maximum Input Variable Value:", 0.3))
      conditionalPanel(condition = "input.distinvarpdf=='Log Normal'",
                       textInput("invarpdfmeanlog","Please Select Mean Log of Input Variable:",0.18),
                       textInput("invarpdfsdlog","Please Select Standard Deviation Log of Input Variable:", 0.3))
    })})
  
  
  output$tab= renderTable(sorted())
  
  
  
}

shinyApp(ui, server)

Where numvar is the number of variables . For each variable I want to dynamically generated a widget which allows the user to then select a probability distribution and its arguments to define that variable. Is this even possible? What am i doing wrong?

messages.author: ca443e6eaa0e78ed
messages.subject: Re: Combine selectInput and Conditional under the same renderUI in Shiny
parts:
The conditions in your conditionalPanel, e.g. `input.inputId=='Normal'`, aren't correct; there isn't any input called "inputId". Instead, you need to replace that string with the actual variable name. Here's one example:

        conditionalPanel(condition = sprintf("input.%s=='Normal'", paste0("moreControls", input$invar[i])),

textInput("invarpdfmean","Please Select Input Variable Mean:",0.25),
          textInput("invarpdfsd","Please Select Input Variable Standard Deviation", 0.02)),

But I have also highlighted two id's that will also need to be made dynamic; as written, there could be multiple textInputs with "invarpdfmean" as an input on the same page, which isn't allowed.

It might be a bit of a stretch for you right now but you may eventually want to use a Shiny module for the per-input controls:
https://shiny.rstudio.com/articles/modules.html Shiny modules have a bit of a learning curve themselves, but the resulting code will be cleaner and easier to reason about.
